name: Salvation in Nightmare
source:
Take the role of Jake, a guy who recently moved to a new big city with his brother after graduation.
Meet new friends and enemies, communicate with Lust and use his powers on others.
Dive into the world of the paranormal and fight demons or live the ordinary life of a mortal.
Develop your characteristics, relationship levels and more in a casual simulator game.
Behold Dreams with different realities through the eyes of other characters using the ability of Lust.
Find the truth about Sins and receive Salvation from Nightmare.
